articles.title: The Complete Guide to Premium Domain Names: Value, Buying, Branding and Marketing
articles.excerpt: Everything you need to know about premium domain names: what they are, how to value one, how to buy it safely, how to pay for it, and how to turn it into traffic, trust and sales.

articles.title: Choosing a Domain Extension: .com, .ca, .io and More
articles.excerpt: How to choose between .com, country codes like .ca, technology extensions like .io and .ai, and new descriptive extensions. Trust, price, renewal cost and who each one suits.

articles.title: Do Premium Domains Help SEO? What Google Says and What Actually Matters
articles.excerpt: Does a premium or exact-match domain improve search rankings? What Google's own guidance says, how a better domain still helps your marketing, and how to move to a new domain without losing traffic.

articles.title: The Domain Name Marketing Playbook: Email, Ads, QR Codes and Vanity URLs
articles.excerpt: How to market with a premium domain: branded email, paid ads, print and QR codes, social profiles, vanity URLs, campaign pages and word of mouth, with a 30 day plan to launch a new name.

articles.title: Domain Transfers, EPP Codes and DNS Explained in Plain English
articles.excerpt: How a domain transfer works from start to finish: registrar, registry and registrant, the EPP authorisation code, the transfer lock, waiting periods, DNS records and what to check so nothing breaks.

articles.title: How to Buy a Premium Domain Safely: Escrow, Checks and Transfer, Step by Step
articles.excerpt: A safe buying process for premium domains: how to check the seller and the name, use escrow, agree terms, take the transfer and secure the domain, plus the red flags that should make you stop.

articles.title: How to Pick a Brand Name and Domain That Lasts
articles.excerpt: A practical naming method for founders: what makes a name memorable, the tests to run before you commit, the mistakes that force a rename, and how to match the name to a domain you can own.

articles.title: How to Value a Premium Domain Name: A Practical Method With Examples
articles.excerpt: A step-by-step method for valuing a premium domain: score the name on six factors, check comparable sales, estimate what the name is worth to your business, and set a fair offer.

articles.title: Premium Domain Payment Plans and Financing: How to Pay Over Time
articles.excerpt: How payment plans for premium domains work, what to compare (term, interest, ownership and missed-payment rules), and how to decide between paying in full and paying over three to twelve months.

articles.title: Premium Domains as Business Assets and Investments
articles.excerpt: How premium domains work as business assets and as investments: where the value comes from, how owners earn from them, the risks, how to hold and account for a domain, and a sensible way to start.

articles.title: Trademarks and Domain Disputes: UDRP Basics for Domain Buyers
articles.excerpt: How trademarks and domain names interact, how to check a name before you buy, and what the UDRP dispute process is: three requirements, how cases work, and how to protect yourself. General information, not legal advice.

articles.title: Website Launch Checklist After Buying a Domain: Your First Week
articles.excerpt: What to do in the first week after you buy a domain: secure it, connect DNS, turn on HTTPS, set up authenticated email, redirect properly, add analytics and Search Console, and publish the core pages.

articles.title: What Is a Premium Domain Name? Meaning, Examples and Why It Costs More
articles.excerpt: A premium domain is a short, memorable, high-demand name that sells for far more than a normal registration. Learn the two meanings of the term, the main types, and how to tell a real premium name from an overpriced one.
